title: Report: How AI is reshaping the entire beauty value chain
summary: From product formulation to the point of sale, artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming the beauty industry and reshaping brand strategies. To assess the scale of this shift and anticipate its implications, Pascale Brousse, founder of Trendsourcing, and Hugo Willemin, analyst and futurist, have conducted an international foresight study examining AI's impact on the cosmetics industry and the challenges it presents for the future.
